# Survival rates

Six- and 12-month OS survival rates are derived from the posterior survival
curves produced by the OS analysis.  This module never refits OS.  It reads
the compact OS curve artifact and the accompanying follow-up sufficiency
metadata, then reports posterior medians and credible intervals by randomized
group.

The 12-month rate is gated: when the OS metadata do not confirm sufficient
follow-up at 365 days, the result is explicitly `blocked` and no rate is
printed.  Missing curves or missing gate metadata are unavailable, not zero.
The same contract can be used for PFS curves once the PFS module produces a
posterior survival artifact.

```{r}
#| eval: false

source(here::here("analysis", "05-secondary", "secondary-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "report-reader.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))

# Survival rates consume OS posterior curves; they do not refit OS.  The
# compact artifact contract uses one row per posterior draw, treatment, and
# time point.  Follow-up sufficiency is a separate OS metadata artifact.
os_curves <- read_result_table(
  here::here("results", "primary", "overall-survival", "survival-curves.parquet")
)
follow_up_sufficiency <- yaml::read_yaml(
  here::here("results", "primary", "overall-survival", "follow-up-sufficiency.yml")
)
follow_up_sufficiency <- as.data.frame(follow_up_sufficiency,
                                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

rate_rows <- list()
for (horizon in c(182L, 365L)) {
  gate <- follow_up_sufficiency[
    follow_up_sufficiency$horizon_days == horizon, , drop = FALSE
  ]
  sufficient <- horizon == 182L ||
    (nrow(gate) == 1L && isTRUE(as.logical(gate$sufficient[[1L]])))
  if (horizon > 182L && !sufficient) {
    rate_rows[[length(rate_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      draw = NA_integer_, tx = NA_integer_, horizon_days = horizon,
      survival_rate = NA_real_, status = "blocked",
      reason = if (nrow(gate) == 1L) as.character(gate$reason[[1L]]) else
        "No follow-up sufficiency metadata.", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    next
  }
  split_key <- interaction(os_curves$draw, os_curves$tx,
                           drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE)
  for (piece in split(os_curves, split_key)) {
    if (max(piece$time, na.rm = TRUE) < horizon) {
      stop("OS curves do not cover the requested survival-rate horizon.")
    }
    rate <- approx(piece$time, piece$survival, xout = horizon, rule = 1)$y
    rate_rows[[length(rate_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      draw = piece$draw[[1L]], tx = piece$tx[[1L]], horizon_days = horizon,
      survival_rate = rate, status = "available",
      reason = "Derived from OS posterior survival curves.",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}
survival_rates <- do.call(rbind, rate_rows)
available <- survival_rates[survival_rates$status == "available", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(available) > 0L) {
  rate_key <- interaction(available$horizon_days, available$tx,
                          drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE)
  rate_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(available, rate_key), function(piece) {
    values <- quantile(piece$survival_rate, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), names = FALSE)
    data.frame(horizon_days = piece$horizon_days[[1L]],
               tx = piece$tx[[1L]], median = values[[2L]],
               lower_95 = values[[1L]], upper_95 = values[[3L]])
  }))
} else {
  rate_summary <- data.frame()
}
write_atomic_parquet(
  rate_summary,
  project_path("results", "secondary", "survival-rates", "summary.parquet")
)
```
